ifconfig and netstat are not deprecated, you just don't have the package that has them.

[stephen@ArchLighthouse ~]$ pacman -Qo /bin/ifconfig
/usr/bin/ifconfig is owned by net-tools 1.60.20130531git-1
[stephen@ArchLighthouse ~]$ pacman -Qo /bin/netstat
/usr/bin/netstat is owned by net-tools 1.60.20130531git-1

You'll need to install net-tools to use them.

Since you have to setup networking for ArchLinux, I've found that just using the following commands will get networking to work on a virtualbox'ed instance of Arch:

systemctl enable dhcpcd
systemctl start dhcpcd

the systemctl enable line makes it start on every boot.
the systemctl start does as you expect, immediately starts the service.
